method: B (launch story) - PPC Guru launched/rebuilt the account ~Nov 2025; compare first complete quarter (Q1 2026) with most recent complete quarter (Q2 2026).
genuine_lead_definition: PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM conversion categories. No local-action / outbound-click categories present in this account.

cost_per_lead.note: rose as budget scaled ~1.89x while leads grew ~1.35x; presented as neutral, not spun as a cut

headline_basis: Q2 2026 = ~14 genuine phone & form leads per month; +35% vs Q1 2026; ~71% of leads are phone calls.
excluded: July 2026 (partial Q3 quarter; 3,367 clicks & 59 form submissions from a Performance Max expansion look anomalous and are flagged for review).
